tokens.name: tide-50
tokens.usage: Lightest Tide tint. Section washes behind ink text.

tokens.name: tide-100
tokens.usage: Ice tint, matching the pale periwinkle of the carton. Selected rows, info backgrounds.

tokens.name: tide-200
tokens.usage: Soft Tide. Decorative fills, liquid and illustration only; not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: tide-300
tokens.usage: Tide on dark grounds: links, primary button fill and liquid glow in the dark theme.

tokens.name: tide-400
tokens.usage: Mid Tide. Illustration, 3D rim light, charts; never body text on white.

tokens.name: tide-500
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds (5.4:1 on the page ground).

tokens.name: tide-600
tokens.usage: Brand cobalt, the wordmark colour. Primary button fill (white label 8.1:1), links, brand text.

tokens.name: tide-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: tide-800
tokens.usage: Deep Tide for large dark panels on light pages.

tokens.name: tide-900
tokens.usage: Ink. Headlines and body text on light grounds; raised surface in the dark theme.

tokens.name: tide-950
tokens.usage: Deepest Tide. Dark-theme page ground and the hero stage.

tokens.name: orchid-50
tokens.usage: Orchid tint. Background behind orchid text in chips and callouts.

tokens.name: orchid-100
tokens.usage: Stronger Orchid tint for highlighted states.

tokens.name: orchid-300
tokens.usage: Orchid on dark grounds: chips, stat bars, the droplet glow.

tokens.name: orchid-500
tokens.usage: The brand dot, a touch calmer than the print magenta (#E32C94). Use only for the dot, the hero droplet and small marks; never for text below 24px or large fills.

tokens.name: orchid-600
tokens.usage: Orchid text and icons on white and orchid-50 (6.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: orchid-700
tokens.usage: Orchid text on orchid-100 and pressed states.

tokens.name: sky-50
tokens.usage: Faintest Sky. Section wash on the white page.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Swirl back layer; tinted bands behind ink text (13:1).

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Swirl middle layer and liquid fills. Decorative only.

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Swirl front layer, sampled from the label. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: sky-400
tokens.usage: Swirl ribbon edges and 3D liquid highlights. Decorative only.

tokens.name: pearl-0
tokens.usage: Pure white. Raised cards on the light theme; the carton's white.

tokens.name: pearl-25
tokens.usage: Light-theme page ground.

tokens.name: pearl-100
tokens.usage: Subtle dividers and disabled fills.

tokens.name: pearl-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines between content blocks.

tokens.name: pearl-400
tokens.usage: Control borders on light grounds (3.4:1 on the page ground).

tokens.name: pearl-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on light grounds (6.9:1 on the page ground).

tokens.name: pearl-700
tokens.usage: Long-form body text alternative to ink.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground: clean white, as Dapo asked.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels; on the white page they separate by shadow-1 or a line border, not by tint.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tinted bands that group related content; pairs with the swirl edge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers; decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, footnotes on any surface (6.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links and brand-coloured text on any surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, the brand cobalt. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on an action fill (8.1:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The magenta accent: benefit chips, check icons, stat bars, the droplet. Small doses only.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind accent or ink text in chips and callouts.

tokens.name: swirl-1
tokens.usage: Swirl back ribbon.

tokens.name: swirl-2
tokens.usage: Swirl middle ribbon.

tokens.name: swirl-3
tokens.usage: Swirl front ribbon.

tokens.name: swirl-sheen
tokens.usage: Thin sheen line that rides the swirl, as on the label.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset (4.5:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success message background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning message background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and contraindication markers; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error message background.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page. Fluid: clamp(44px, 6vw + 1rem, 72px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers on the landing page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: Two sprays, up to six hours

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Evidence figures, always with a label and a citation marker.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display heading. Max 60 characters per line.
styles.sample: A lipid-based spray that lubricates and shields the mouth for up to six hours.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text. 18px minimum for patient-facing copy.
styles.sample: Aquoral forms a thin lipid film on the oral mucosa that limits moisture loss.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Dense UI text, table cells, form hints. Never below 16px for patients.
styles.sample: Two sprays, three to four times a day.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and link-button labels, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes, citations and image captions. Use ink-muted.
styles.sample: Mouly S. et al., 2007. Randomised trial, n=150.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dosage, licence numbers, lot codes and other values people copy or compare.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.usage: Card padding; paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons and form controls.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, the language switch, droplet badges.
